Question: Consider the set of complex numbers \(z\) satisfying \(|1+z+z^2|=4.\) The maximum value of the imaginary part of \(z\) can be written in the form \(\dfrac{\sqrt{m}}{n},\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(m+n?\)
